structures.name: Lateral Ventricle
structures.about: The paired cerebrospinal fluid cavities within each cerebral hemisphere, curving beneath the corpus callosum.

structures.name: Choroid Plexus
structures.about: The spongy vascular tissue within the ventricles that produces cerebrospinal fluid.

structures.name: Fornix
structures.about: The arching fiber bundle carrying hippocampal output forward to the mammillary bodies and septal region.

structures.name: Third Ventricle
structures.about: The narrow midline cavity between the two halves of the thalamus.

structures.name: Massa Intermedia
structures.about: The bridge of gray matter crossing the third ventricle and joining the two halves of the thalamus.

structures.name: Thalamus
structures.about: The large paired mass of gray matter that relays nearly all sensory information on its way to the cortex.

structures.name: Optic Tracts
structures.about: The bands of visual fibers running back from the optic chiasm toward the lateral geniculate nucleus.

structures.name: Hypothalamus
structures.about: The region below the thalamus that governs autonomic function, hormone release, temperature, hunger, and thirst.

structures.name: Mammillothalamic Tract
structures.about: The bundle carrying fibers from the mammillary bodies up to the anterior thalamus, part of the limbic circuit.

structures.name: Mammillary Bodies
structures.about: The paired rounded nuclei on the ventral hypothalamus that receive hippocampal output through the fornix.
